en: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I want is to draw out the whole of a Pokémon's potential.
If that strength comes from the bond between Pokémon and Trainer, so be it. If it takes something cold and mechanical, so be that too.
I've travelled all over Unova battling Trainers to test the one idea against the other. You're the best test yet. Shall we?
So strong! You really are a remarkable Trainer. So tell me...
Do you think you can reach even greater heights by understanding your Pokémon?
I see! To me, that's the ideal answer. You bring out your Pokémon's power by respecting them. How wonderful!
I see... An honest answer. Don't lose heart. The reason you're so strong is that you treat your Pokémon well, whether you know it or not.
You've given me plenty to think about. As thanks, I'll switch off one of the barrier's switches myself. The other is your problem!
Colress pressed a switch on the wall. Somewhere in the ship, something hummed and went quiet.
Whether Team Plasma wins or you do will decide what the bond between people and Pokémon becomes. I'm looking forward to seeing which.
